about.heroParagraph1:
Facing the rapid transformation of the AI era and increasingly high customer demands, Sun* has chosen a capability diversification strategy — not only striving to be elite in our respective fields, but aiming higher, where every Sunner is a "problem-solver" who can tackle every challenge in projects, for clients, and for society.
Inspired by diverse capabilities, agile development and the spirit of going deeper to break through in the AI era, "Root Further" was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards Ceremony 2025.
Beyond its surface meaning, "Root Further" is our journey of continuously reaching farther, anchoring deeper, touching the hidden "geological layers" to survive, rise, and nurture the ever-burning passion of Sun* people to create value.
about.quote: "A tree with deep roots fears no storm"
about.heroParagraph2: Against storms, only trees with strong enough roots can stand firm. An organization with individuals confident in their diverse capabilities, ready to create and embrace challenges, and in control of change — this is an organization that not only weathers disruptions, but harnesses every advantage and conquers the challenges of the times. More than just a name for a new chapter in the organization's journey, "Root Further" is a call to each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dare to go deep, unlock all potential, dare to break limits, dare to become the most versatile and outstanding version of ourselves. Because in the AI era, diverse capabilities and leveraging the power of the times are the prerequisites for longevity.

kudos.title: Sun* Kudos
kudos.description: A peer recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time for all Sunners. The activity will be launched in November 2025, encouraging Sun* people to share recognition and appreciation for colleagues on the system announced by the organizing committee. This will be material for the Heads Council to refer to during the selection process.

communityStandards.title: Community Standards
communityStandards.intro: To foster a positive and genuine recognition environment, Sun* encourages all Sunners to follow these guidelines when sending a Kudo:
communityStandards.rule1: Be specific and genuine — describe the action or contribution you appreciate.
communityStandards.rule2: Be respectful and professional — keep language polite and non-discriminatory.
communityStandards.rule3: Do not share another person's sensitive personal information.
communityStandards.rule4: Do not use Kudos for advertising or unrelated content.
communityStandards.rule5: Violations will be removed and accounts may have their Kudo-sending rights restricted.

thele.receiverSectionTitle: KUDOS RECIPIENT: HERO BADGE FOR POSITIVE INFLUENCE
thele.receiverDesc: Based on the number of teammates who send you Kudos, you will receive the corresponding Hero Badge, displayed directly next to your profile name.
thele.newHeroDesc: The journey of spreading goodness begins — the first words of appreciation and recognition have found their way to you.
thele.risingHeroDesc: Your image is growing in the hearts of your teammates through your kindness and dedication.
thele.superHeroDesc: You have become a trusted and beloved icon — someone always ready to help and remembered by many teammates.
thele.legendHeroCondition: More than 20 people sent you Kudos
thele.legendHeroDesc: You have become a legend — someone who left an unforgettable mark on the team through heart and action.
thele.senderSectionTitle: KUDOS SENDER: COLLECT ALL 6 ICONS, GET A MYSTERY GIFT
thele.senderDesc: Every Kudos you send will be published on the system and receive ❤️ reactions from the Sunner community. For every 5 ❤️ reactions, you unlock 1 Secret Box, with a chance to receive one of SAA's 6 exclusive icons.
thele.senderCollectionReward: Sunners who collect all 6 icons will receive a mystery gift from SAA 2025.
thele.nationalKudosDesc: The 5 Kudos that receive the most ❤️ reactions across all of Sun* will officially become Kudos Quốc Dân and receive a special gift from SAA 2025: Root Further.
